IPCC_AR6.basis: Published energy-system scenarios through 2100; not a forecast for 2200. Demand, electrification and supply options vary across pathways.

IAU_constants.basis: Resolution B3: nominal solar irradiance 1361 W/m2 and luminosity 3.828e26 W.

NASA_solar.basis: Solar irradiance at Earth and geometry of global-average incoming sunlight.

NASA_Earth.basis: Planet size; model uses rounded mean radius 6371 km and spherical surface area.

NASA_Mars.basis: Mars solar irradiance 586.2 W/m2, above the atmosphere at average orbital distance.

NASA_thermal.basis: Spacecraft reject heat radiatively; area, emissivity, temperature and surroundings matter.

NASA_lunar_night.basis: Illustrative 14-Earth-day lunar night, not universal polar darkness duration.

NASA_fission.basis: 40 kW-class lunar fission development reference; not an operating lunar fleet.

NASA_2030.basis: Lunar reactor development target; not delivered capability.

NASA_SBSP.basis: Concept-level assessment of solar power beamed to Earth; distinct from electricity used in space.

NASA_ISAM.basis: Servicing, assembly and manufacturing research. Does not demonstrate self-sufficient orbital industry.

ITER_tritium.basis: Blanket testing and fuel-cycle development remain prerequisites for relevant fusion routes.

DOE_fast_reactor.basis: Fast reactors and repeated fuel recycling can extend resource use; full fuel-cycle engineering and economics remain necessary.

DOE_electrolysis.basis: Electrolyzer performance targets; 55 kWh/kg system electricity used as a transparent present-scale budgeting assumption, not a 2100 prediction.

IEA_desalination.basis: Seawater reverse-osmosis electricity varies with process and boundaries. Model assumes 3 kWh/m3 and excludes inland distribution.

Heat_research.basis: Theoretical study of persistent energy growth and waste heat; not used to assign a catastrophe date or a temperature forecast.

Q1.basis: Project electricity-generation baseline and 2050 planning cases.

Q3.basis: Project ocean proposal; 15% ocean in 2050. Q4 is a separate speculative extension.

OTEC_2025.basis: Primary coupled-model study: OTEC sustainability depends on output, duration and climate state. It does not certify a 7 TW ecological safety limit.

OTEC_2013.basis: Early global circulation model assessment. The 7 TW result is a comparison, not a universal ecological safety threshold.

Tidal_review.basis: Quasi-practical 110 TWh/year estimate from 90 sites, about 20% of 426 candidates; not a complete global resource ceiling.

FPV_ecology.basis: Three North Sea water-column simulations. Results for coverage and primary production are local model findings, not a global permitting rule.

Open_ocean_wind.basis: North Atlantic simulation with large kinetic-energy replenishment. The 6 W/m² result is context-specific, not a guaranteed global farm yield.

UNCLOS.basis: Articles 56, 60 and 87 establish relevant jurisdiction, freedoms and obligations; the high seas are not a legal vacuum.
